news.text: Presenting at IEEE ISMAR 2026, Bari. Privacy on Autopilot — the ARPA study on assistant autonomy and privacy awareness — runs in the research track, Oct 5–9.
news.short: PRESENTING “PRIVACY ON AUTOPILOT” · IEEE ISMAR 2026 · BARI · OCT 5–9

news.text: Privacy on Autopilot accepted to IEEE ISMAR 2026. Automation redistributes the privacy burden rather than removing it — chapter 5 of the dissertation, to appear in the proceedings.
GEM at 50. Sponsored alumni attendee at the National GEM Consortium’s 50th Annual Conference & Board Meeting, Gaylord Texan.
The Purple Flame submitted to the SSRC Just Tech Fellowship (2027 cohort). The myth and the mechanism — a 5-minute Afro-cyberpunk short plus a 2027 build-year work proposal.
Dissertation defended. Protection Behind the Veil: Gaze, Privacy, and Context-Aware Adaptation in Extended Reality — Virginia Tech, chair Doug A. Bowman.

Hidden in Plain Gaze — manuscript complete. Gaze representation as a privacy control: engineered features keep ~85% of task utility while cutting re-identification by an order of magnitude (206 identities, HoloAssist).
iAR taxonomy preprint on arXiv. Towards Intelligent Augmented Reality: a taxonomy of context, an architecture, and an empirical study (with Davari, Stover, Giovannelli, Bowman).
GoldiLocks Zoning presented at ACM SUI 2024. Gaze alone, read as passive context, places VR notifications without imaging the world.
Apple. Graduate camera-hardware research intern — connecting camera design specifications to perceptual end-user experience (May–Sep 2022).
1st place, IEEE VR 2022 3DUI Contest. Clean the Ocean — new Go-Go and World-in-Miniature modifications, with the 3D Interaction Group.
Adobe Research. Graduate AR/VR research intern — notification delivery in VR/AR that balances understandability with minimal distraction (May–Aug 2021).
Started the PhD at Virginia Tech — 3D Interaction Group, advised by Doug A. Bowman. GEM Fellow.
